{{nihongo|'''Kusumoto Shrine'''|樟本神社 (八尾市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Kawachi Province]].

{{commons category|Category:Kusumoto-jinja (Yao)}}
[[ja:樟本神社 (八尾市)]]

{{wikidata link|Q11542244|ja|樟本神社 (八尾市)|grok=none|check_date=2026-05-31}}

== Japanese content ==
'''Kusumoto Shrine''' (くすもとじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Yao, Osaka|ar|ياو (أوساكا)|bcl|Yao, Osaka|be|Яо|bg|Яо|ca|Yao (Osaka)|ce|Яо (Осака)|ceb|Yao-shi|de|Yao (Osaka)|eo|Jao|es|Yao (Osaka)|et|Yao|fa|یائو، اوساکا|fi|Yao|fr|Yao (Osaka)|ga|Yao|gl|Yao|hy|Յաո|id|Yao, Osaka|it|Yao (Osaka)|ja|八尾市|ko|야오시|ms|Yao, Osaka|mzn|یائو، اوساکا|nl|Yao (Osaka)|no|Yao (Osaka)|pl|Yao (miasto)|pt|Yao (Osaka)|ro|Yao (municipiu)|ru|Яо (Япония)|sco|Yao, Osaka|sh|Yao, Osaka|simple|Yao, Osaka|sr|Јао|sv|Yao, Osaka|tg|Яо|th|ยาโอะ|tl|Yao, Osaka|tr|Yao, Osaka|tt|Яо (Осака)|uk|Яо (Осака)|ur|یاو، اوساکا|vi|Yao, Ōsaka|war|Yao, Osaka|zh|八尾市|zh_classical|八尾市|zh_min_nan|Yao-chhī|zh_yue|八尾|qid=Q490872}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is a shikinaisha recorded in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}} as "Kusumoto Shrine, three seats, Kuwa-yuki, Shiki District, Kawachi Province," and today it is enshrined at three locations in Yao: Kinomoto (former {{ill|Tanboku district|ja|丹北郡|zh|丹北郡|qid=Q11368489}}), Kita-Kinomoto, and Minami-Kinomoto (former {{ill|Shiki district|ja|志紀郡|zh|志紀郡|qid=Q11491125}}).

=== Overview ===
Its founding date is unknown, but it is thought to date back to before the Kofun period. The enshrined deity was originally regarded as {{ill|Kodama (spirit)|ar|كوداما|as|কোডামা|de|Kodama (Geist)|es|Kodama|fi|Kodama|fr|Kodama|ga|Kodama (sprid)|id|Kodama (mitologi)|it|Kodama (mitologia)|ja|木霊|ko|고다마|mk|Кодама (дух)|mni|ꯀꯣꯗꯃ (ꯊꯋꯥꯢ)|no|Kodama|pl|Kodama (duch)|pt|Kodama|ro|Kodama (spirit)|ru|Кодама|th|โคดามะ|tr|Kodama|uk|Кодама (дух)|zh|木靈|qid=Q1515938}} (tree spirit), and later identified with {{ill|Futsu-no-mitama|ja|布都御魂|zh|布都御魂|qid=Q11059754|lt=Futsu Omikami}} and {{ill|Nigihayahi|Q10949054|qid=Q10949054|lt=Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto}}. Because this area was former territory of the {{ill|Mononobe clan|Q1755836|qid=Q1755836}}, it is thought that deities revered by {{ill|Mononobe no Moriya|fa|مونونوبه نو موریا|fr|Mononobe no Moriya|ja|物部守屋|nl|Mononobe no Moriya|pt|Mononobe no Moriya|ru|Мононобэ-но Мория|sh|Mononobe no Moriya|th|โมโนโนเบะ โนะ โมริยะ|uk|Мононобе но Морія|zh|物部守屋|zh_classical|物部守屋|qid=Q2424736}} as guardian gods were brought here in the reign of Emperor Yomei.

Originally there were three seats in Kimoto village, but when Kita-Kimoto split off and later Minami-Kimoto split off, one seat each was divided to those villages.

It is on the west side along the former Osaka Chuo Kanjo Line (former Yao-Fujiidera Line). In the precincts is a pond about 3 meters in diameter said to be where {{ill|Mononobe no Moriya|fa|مونونوبه نو موریا|fr|Mononobe no Moriya|ja|物部守屋|nl|Mononobe no Moriya|pt|Mononobe no Moriya|ru|Мононобэ-но Мория|sh|Mononobe no Moriya|th|โมโนโนเบะ โนะ โมริยะ|uk|Мононобе но Морія|zh|物部守屋|zh_classical|物部守屋|qid=Q2424736}}'s head was washed. There is a children's park in the center of the grounds, with a small shrine building at the back. Among the three shrines, this one is the smallest in scale.

It is on the west side along the city road (former Yao-Fujiidera Line) a little south of the Kinomoto intersection on the old Osaka Chuo Kanjo Line. The shrine buildings are on the north side of the grounds. On the south side is '''Nichira-ji''', a {{ill|Buddhism|Q748|qid=Q748}} {{ill|Buddhist temple|Q5393308|qid=Q5393308}} of the Obaku school; its principal image is {{ill|Bhaisajyaguru|Q854773|qid=Q854773}}. It is said that {{ill|Emperor Bidatsu|Q316637|qid=Q316637}} granted this land to {{ill|Nichira|ja|日羅|qid=Q11510262}}, who had been called back from {{ill|Paekche|ar|مملكة بايكتشي|ast|Baekje|az|Pekçe krallığı|azb|باکچه شاهلیغی|be|Пэкчэ|bg|Пекче|br|Baekje|ca|Paekche|cdo|Báik-cá̤|ckb|بایکجی|cs|Päkče|da|Baekje|de|Baekje|eo|Baekje|es|Baekje|eu|Baekje|fa|بکجه|fi|Baekje|fr|Baekje|gl|Baekje|hi|बेकजे|hr|Baekje|hu|Pekcse|id|Baekje|io|Baekje|it|Baekje|ja|百済|ka|პექჩე|km|បែកជេ|ko|백제|ku|Keyaniya Baekjeyê|lv|Pekče|mk|Пекче|mn|Пэгжэ|ms|Baekje|my|ဘက်ကျယ်|mzn|بیکچه|nl|Paekche|no|Baekje|pl|Baekje|pt|Baekje|ro|Baekje|ru|Пэкче|sh|Baekje|si|බෙක්ජේ|simple|Baekje|sr|Пекче|sv|Baekje|sw|Baekje|th|อาณาจักรแพ็กเจ|tl|Baekje|tr|Baekje|uk|Пекче|uz|Pekche|vi|Bách Tế|wuu|百济|zh|百济|zh_classical|百濟|zh_min_nan|Pek-chè|zh_yue|百濟|qid=Q28428}}, and Nichira built a temple here and enshrined a Yakushi Nyorai image.
